bundles.name: Nourish & Shine Duo
bundles.shortDescription: Two botanical essentials for your hair-care routine. Pair Magali Botanical Hair Oil with Herbal Hair Grease for everyday softness, shine, and manageability.
bundles.description: Bring two complementary hair-care formats into one routine. Botanical Hair Oil combines 14 botanicals with olive, castor, and coconut oils. Herbal Hair Grease brings together herbs, natural oils, and shea butter in a richer format. This duo is a convenient way to try both Magali hair-care essentials together.
bundles.includedText: 1 × Botanical Hair Oil — 250 ml; 1 × Herbal Hair Grease — 185 g.
bundles.bestFor: Customers trying both hair-care products together.
